summary_claims.claim: No one may provide, advertise or offer therapy or psychotherapy, including through Internet-based AI, unless a licensed professional provides it; violation is an unfair trade practice
Supplementary AI use requires written notice and the client's consent; AI may not make independent therapeutic decisions

note: Signed 13 Apr 2026, Public Law 2025 chapter 687, in force 29 Jul 2026 per the Legislative Digest: all official. Search found no amendment. One thing to look at later: Maine's online statutes list one of the Title 32 sections as 3300-J-1, which may be a revisor renumbering of the section the notes call 3300-J.
